Hamstr 0.2.1 fixes unwanted picture-in-picture windows and clarifies download-engine settings.

- Fix picture-in-picture remaining enabled after pausing or closing a video. PiP now follows the Activity's current playback state and is disabled for audio, images and missing or detached players.
- Keep the full Hamstr interface out of the PiP window, including when playback ends during the transition.
- Use Cheek as the default download engine for new installations and missing settings. Existing saved engine choices are preserved.
- Show the bundled Cheek version and add **Check version** to read the installed executable.
- Add automatic app-update checks and update actions to the Cheek settings. Cheek updates arrive through Hamstr APK updates; yt-dlp link-resolver updates remain separate.

Still bundles **Cheek 0.1.1**. This release does not add background clipboard monitoring.

Install over Hamstr 0.2.0 or update through Settings → About. APKs use the same release signing key. `arm64-v8a` fits most phones; `universal` includes all supported ABIs. Verify downloads using `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
